title: NBA Prediction SOTA 2026: S14 ExtraTrees 200f Fleet Best + S13 CatBoost Discovery
sources_searched: MDPI 2026 (doi:10.3390/info17010056) — Uncertainty-Aware ML for NBA forecasting, LR Brier 0.199
Nature Scientific Reports 2025 (doi:10.1038/s41598-025-13657-1) — Stacked ensemble NBA
IEEE Xplore 2025 (doi:10.1109/11030489) — Comparing ML methods for NBA outcome prediction

new_fleet_best.significance: Beats S22 0.22027. Below oracle CV 0.22085. ExtraTrees 200f > XGBoost 63f at this data scale.

catboost_signal.significance: First CatBoost result in fleet. Sub-oracle-threshold at gen 6. Strong signal for political domain.

proposals.title: Seed ExtraTrees 200f explicitly in all island GA init populations
proposals.rationale: S14 proves ET 200f beats sparse XGBoost 63f. GA should pre-seed ET(n_estimators=300, max_features=sqrt) + 200f configs.

proposals.title: Add CatBoost to political GA engine pool
proposals.rationale: S13 CatBoost hit 0.22060 at gen 6 from fresh restart. Political domain has many categorical event features — CatBoost handles natively vs XGBoost/LGB one-hot encoding.

proposals.title: LR + isotonic calibration in S14 GA pool
proposals.rationale: S14 at 0.22019 (ET 200f). SOTA shows LR achieves 0.199. Add LR(C=0.1, solver=saga) + CalibratedClassifierCV(isotonic) as explicit GA candidate.
proposals.expected_brier_gain: 0.220→0.219 within 200 gens if LR wins selection

proposals.title: Revive Kaggle P100 stacked ensemble run (STALE since Mar 28)
proposals.rationale: Nature 2025 stacked ensemble promising. S14 ET 200f alone at 0.22019 — stacking with XGBoost+LR meta could approach 0.199 SOTA.

s22_restart_note: S22 (previous fleet best 0.22027, XGBoost 63f, gen 861) restarted and now at gen 38 brier 0.22431 stagnation=16. Re-seed the 63f XGBoost config that achieved 0.22027 into S22 init population via next diversify.

fleet_gap_analysis.comment: Fleet CPU-only islands within 0.021 of LR SOTA. TabICL gap 0.009 achievable via GPU run. LR approach could close gap entirely.
